preview.description: Preview a production build (mirrors `npm run preview`).

build-css.description: Standalone Tailwind watch build (mirrors `npm run build-css`).

serve.description: Serve a built dist/ over plain HTTP without Vite (mirrors `npm run serve`).

test:unit.description: Vitest unit suite, single run (mirrors `npm run test:unit`).

test:unit:watch.description: Vitest unit suite, watch mode (mirrors `npm run test:unit:watch`).

test:report.description: Open the last Playwright HTML report (mirrors `npm run test:report`).

assert:no-sentry-without-dsn.description: Prove the Sentry SDK is tree-shaken out of a DSN-less build (mirrors `npm run assert:no-sentry-without-dsn`).

assert:site.description: Check the site's metadata, cross-links and crawler files against src/lib/site.js (mirrors `npm run assert:site`). Also runs inside every `vite build`.

check:lockfiles.description: package.json, package-lock.json and deno.lock list the same direct dependencies (mirrors `npm run check:lockfiles`).

lint:content.description: Validate public/markdown/*.md against the catalog conventions (mirrors `npm run lint:content`).

check:links.description: Check that the catalog's outbound links still resolve; set GITHUB_TOKEN to also catch archived and renamed repos (mirrors `npm run check:links`).

check.description: Type-check the JSX/JS source with Deno's built-in TypeScript checker (new — there was no type checking at all before this migration).
